title: Tundra / jungle ground detail and meadow field detail are visible; seams are stepped, not hard
steps: Look at the first screen and after walking 100 s
expected: Ground has detail (cracks, drifts, roots, litter, flowers) and softer seams
actual: Tundra shows cracks, frost and glints on snow; jungle shows roots, litter and moss; meadow shows flowers, pebbles and tufts. Land/water seams are pixel-stepped with a darker rim, readable and not harsh. Hooks agree (biomeDetail tundra 917 tiles, jungle 1004, fieldDetail flowers 58).

title: Rocket lift-off is now mid-screen, clear of the toast and buttons
steps: Meadow dock, craft raft + rocket core, tap Sail, tap Sail to Red Waste
Capture at 0.3 s, 1.2 s, 2.2 s, then the landing
expected: Rocket rises in the open, not at the bottom edge
actual: Rocket and smoke sit in the middle of the screen, 'Lift-off! Tap to skip.' toast above, fade-out at the end, landing on the pad with Air 90 s. Same at 195 px wide. 0 errors.

title: No-reward-gap check only done as 100 s real-time runs per island, not 10 minutes
steps: Keyboard bot, real time, 1280x720, 100 s each on meadow, jungle, tundra, mars
expected: No more than 45 s without a reward event
actual: Bot logged gather/spot/sparkle events only (it did not walk to glints, and drops are not in events()). Measured max gaps: meadow 36 s, jungle 65 s, tundra 66 s, mars 52 s on those events alone, but fights gave 20-28 kills and drop toasts in 100 s on jungle/tundra/mars, so real rewards were frequent. Cannot claim the 45 s rule passes or fails.

title: At 195 px wide the how-to card covers half the screen and the hero; the hint toast sits under the Soothe/Decor/Sail buttons
steps: Open any island at 195x844 touch (fresh profile)
Look at the first frame; then tap Sail on the dock at 195 px after lift-off to mars
expected: Hero visible, buttons not covering text
actual: The how-to card fills y 130-420 and hides the hero on all four islands; on meadow the Decor button overlaps the toast, on mars the Sail button overlaps the toast so 'open the sea chart.' is cut to 'open the sea'. HUD name truncates to 'Wanderer ...'. At 390 the card still covers the centre on first load (closable with the X, closes when a hostile appears).
suspect: game/games/isles/isles.css (howto card, toast vs button column)

title: Tundra and reef start with 0 creatures on screen
expected: Something to react to on the first screen
actual: creatures().length is 0 on tundra and reef, 1 on meadow/jungle/mars. A hint toast ('A glint of ice is to the south') names an action, so the screen is not dead.

title: Desktop HUD stats line is cut with ellipses when the terrain name is long
steps: Read the HUD line under the hero bar
expected: Full line or a clean wrap
actual: 'XP 96 Kills 20 Lo... shallow water (slow...' is clipped mid-word twice.
